lines.zh: 夜里走路，眼睛比脚步忙。
lines.en: Walking at night, my eyes work harder than my legs.

lines.zh: 我尽量踩在软土上，不出声。
lines.en: I step on soft soil so as not to make noise.

lines.zh: 月亮够亮，我不用看路。
lines.en: The moon is bright enough; I do not need the path.

lines.zh: 走慢一点，草丛里的东西会动。
lines.en: Walk slower and things in the grass start to move.

lines.zh: 十九点生命，够我小心一辈子。
lines.en: Nineteen points of life keeps me careful forever.

lines.zh: 我的脚印很浅，风一吹就没了。
lines.en: My footprints are shallow and the wind erases them.

lines.zh: 夜里赶路，不点灯也不迷路。
lines.en: Travelling at night, I need no lamp and never stray.

lines.zh: 我绕开营地，那里的火太吵。
lines.en: I skirt the camp; their fire is too loud.

lines.zh: 走一段，回头看一眼，再走。
lines.en: A few steps, a glance back, then more steps.

lines.zh: 路边的草扫过，痒得很轻。
lines.en: The roadside grass sweeps past, a light tickle.

lines.zh: 沙地上走，脚印会自己合上。
lines.en: On sand, my tracks close themselves behind me.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但很少停。
lines.en: I do not walk fast, but I rarely stop.

lines.zh: 夜风里有吃的味道，在左边。
lines.en: Night wind carries a food smell on my left.

lines.zh: 影子比我先到前面的石头。
lines.en: My shadow reaches the stone ahead of me.

lines.zh: 我踩着落叶走，尽量踩边缘。
lines.en: I tread the leaf edges to stay quiet.

lines.zh: 前面的水坑反光，我绕开它。
lines.en: A puddle shines; I step around it.

lines.zh: 我蹲在暗处，只是看着，不吃。
lines.en: I crouch in the dark and only watch, not eat.

lines.zh: 夜很长，够我把星星数两遍。
lines.en: The night is long enough to count the stars twice.

lines.zh: 那边的草在响，我转头去看。
lines.en: The grass there rustles, and I turn to look.

lines.zh: 我什么都不掉，走时也别找。
lines.en: I drop nothing, so do not search where I stood.

lines.zh: 呼吸放轻，连自己都听不见。
lines.en: I breathe so softly even I cannot hear it.

lines.zh: 月光落在背上，暖得刚好。
lines.en: Moonlight rests on my back, exactly warm enough.

lines.zh: 我打了个小哈欠，眼睛发涩。
lines.en: A small yawn escapes me, and my eyes water.

lines.zh: 这块石头我蹲了三夜了。
lines.en: I have crouched on this stone for three nights.

lines.zh: 远处传来叫声，我抬头去听。
lines.en: A call sounds far off, and I raise my head to it.

lines.zh: 我没在等谁，只是不想动。
lines.en: I am not waiting for anyone; I just do not want to move.

lines.zh: 夜里安静，我的心跳听得清。
lines.en: In the quiet night I can hear my own heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我挪了挪位置，扫掉一片叶。
lines.en: I shift my footing and clear away a leaf.

lines.zh: 天快亮了，我该往林子里挪。
lines.en: Dawn is close; I should shift toward the trees.

lines.zh: 我理了理自己，样子有点乱。
lines.en: I tidy myself; I look a little rumpled.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔前爪，又放下来。
lines.en: I lick a forepaw and set it down.

lines.zh: 树洞里传出响动，我竖起耳朵。
lines.en: Something stirs in the hollow; ears up.

lines.zh: 月亮偏了，我跟着挪了挪。
lines.en: The moon has shifted; so do I.

lines.zh: 我趴下来，把下巴搁在爪上。
lines.en: I lie down, chin on my paws.

lines.zh: 你看我，我也看你，谁也别动。
lines.en: You look at me, I look at you; neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在夜里很亮，别怕。
lines.en: My eyes are bright in the dark; do not be afraid.

lines.zh: 你手里有吃的吗？我看的是手。
lines.en: Is there food in your hand? That is what I watch.

lines.zh: 看清了，你不是猎人。
lines.en: Now I see: you are not a hunter.

lines.zh: 我歪头，是在听你的呼吸。
lines.en: My head tilts because I am listening to your breathing.

lines.zh: 别蹲下来，那样我会以为你要喂我。
lines.en: Do not crouch; I will think you mean to feed me.

lines.zh: 我们互相盯了很久，你输了。
lines.en: We stared a long while; you blinked first.

lines.zh: 夜里看东西，我看得比你久。
lines.en: I can see in the dark longer than you can.

lines.zh: 你身上的火光，映在我眼里。
lines.en: The firelight on you is mirrored in my eyes.

lines.zh: 我看了你三秒，决定不跑。
lines.en: Three seconds of looking, and I decide not to run.

lines.zh: 你靠近一点，我就退半步。
lines.en: One step from you, half a step back from me.

lines.zh: 夜里什么都能看见，包括你。
lines.en: At night I see everything, including you.

lines.zh: 疼！我只是在吃草啊。
lines.en: Ow! I was only eating grass.

lines.zh: 十九点生命，掉一点都心疼。
lines.en: Nineteen points of life; every point stings.

lines.zh: 我跑起来，脚步踩得乱响。
lines.en: I bolt, my steps clattering loud.

lines.zh: 你为什么打我？我没惹你。
lines.en: Why strike me? I did nothing to you.

lines.zh: 伤口不大，但我怕得发抖。
lines.en: The wound is small, but I tremble with fear.

lines.zh: 我钻进草里，血味会引东西来。
lines.en: I dive into the grass; blood draws things.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从梦里打醒了。
lines.en: That blow woke me out of a dream.

lines.zh: 我绕着你跑，不敢靠近。
lines.en: I circle you at a run, afraid to come near.

lines.zh: 身上被扯下一块，很疼的。
lines.en: A piece of me came away, and it hurts.

lines.zh: 别追了，我跑得比你久。
lines.en: Stop chasing; I can run longer than you.

lines.zh: 那个味道，是给我留的吗？
lines.en: That smell — is it meant for me?

lines.zh: 我闻到食物了，脚步就轻了。
lines.en: I smell food, and my steps get light.

lines.zh: 你晃一晃手里的东西，我就来。
lines.en: Wiggle what you hold, and I will come.

lines.zh: 别走太快，我跟不上你的手。
lines.en: Not so fast; I cannot keep up with your hand.

lines.zh: 食物在左边，我眼睛也在左边。
lines.en: The food is on the left; so are my eyes.

lines.zh: 我很听话，只要有吃的。
lines.en: I am very obedient, as long as there is food.

lines.zh: 这一小把，够我跟你走一段。
lines.en: This small handful buys a stretch of my company.

lines.zh: 我凑近了闻，闻了又闻。
lines.en: I lean in and sniff, then sniff again.

lines.zh: 你口袋里还有吗？我听见纸响。
lines.en: Anything else in your pocket? I heard paper.

lines.zh: 先让我吃一口，别的等下说。
lines.en: One bite first; we can discuss the rest after.

lines.zh: 我愿意靠近，但只到手臂那么远。
lines.en: I will come close, but only to arm's length.

lines.zh: 吃完这一口，我还会看着你。
lines.en: After this bite, I will still be watching you.

lines.zh: 这味道比草好，草太淡了。
lines.en: This beats grass; grass is far too bland.

lines.zh: 我小跑过来，脚步都乱了。
lines.en: I trot over, and my steps lose their rhythm.

lines.zh: 你把东西藏身后，我也看得见。
lines.en: Hidden behind your back still smells.

lines.zh: 我闻两下，先舔一口再吃。
lines.en: Two sniffs, one lick, then eat.

lines.zh: 撞到我了，我不生气，只是让开。
lines.en: You bumped me; I am not angry, just stepping aside.

lines.zh: 别踩我的脚，会疼的。
lines.en: Mind my feet; that hurts.

lines.zh: 这么轻的碰撞，我连头都不抬。
lines.en: Such a light bump, I do not even lift my head.

lines.zh: 我就十九点生命，禁不起推。
lines.en: I have nineteen points of life; do not shove.

lines.zh: 你挤过来，我往旁边挪了挪。
lines.en: You crowded in, so I shuffled aside.

lines.zh: 贴这么近，我往后缩了缩。
lines.en: Too close; I shrink back a little.

lines.zh: 撞一下没事，别再来第二下。
lines.en: One bump is fine; do not make it two.

lines.zh: 我身子软，撞起来不疼吧。
lines.en: I am soft-bodied; that cannot have hurt you.

lines.zh: 你挡路了，我从你腿边过。
lines.en: You are in the way; I will pass by your legs.

lines.zh: 我被挤得退了两步，站稳了。
lines.en: I got pushed back two steps, and I am steady again.

lines.zh: 夜里的叫声，是叫同类的。
lines.en: My call in the night is meant for my own kind.

lines.zh: 我找伴的方式，是一起吃点草。
lines.en: My way of courting is sharing a patch of grass.

lines.zh: 两只夜行者靠近，会先互相闻。
lines.en: Two of us meet and sniff each other first.

lines.zh: 喂饱我们俩，才会有小夜行者。
lines.en: Feed us both, and there will be small night watchers.

lines.zh: 我叫声不高，但能传过整片林子。
lines.en: My call is not loud, but it crosses the whole wood.

lines.zh: 别站中间，我们在互相闻味道。
lines.en: Do not stand between us; we are trading scents.

lines.zh: 成对之后，走夜路就不孤单了。
lines.en: Once paired, the night road is no longer lonely.

lines.zh: 我绕着它走了三圈，它没走。
lines.en: I circled it three times, and it stayed.

lines.zh: 同类很少，遇到了要好好待着。
lines.en: Our kind is few; when we meet, we stay close.

lines.zh: 草地上并排站着，就是我们的礼。
lines.en: Standing side by side in the grass is our ceremony.

lines.zh: 地上有吃的，我先闻再捡。
lines.en: Food on the ground: I sniff before I take it.

lines.zh: 我不捡亮的东西，只捡能吃的。
lines.en: I do not pick up shiny things, only edible ones.

lines.zh: 这一小块，我叼着走远点吃。
lines.en: This small piece I carry off to eat alone.

lines.zh: 别抢，我嘴里已经有一份了。
lines.en: Do not grab it; I already have some in my mouth.

lines.zh: 掉了的东西，掉了就归地上。
lines.en: Dropped things belong to the ground once dropped.

lines.zh: 我衔起来的时候很小心，一点没掉。
lines.en: I carry it carefully and do not drop a crumb.

lines.zh: 这一口我留着，等夜里再吃。
lines.en: I will save this bite for later in the night.

lines.zh: 捡东西的时候，我还在听四周。
lines.en: Even while picking things up, I listen around me.

lines.zh: 这块太硬，我放下又捡起来。
lines.en: Too hard; I put it down and pick it up again.

lines.zh: 吃完了，地上什么也不剩。
lines.en: When I finish, nothing is left on the ground.

lines.zh: 有动静，我先趴低一点看。
lines.en: Something moved; I lower myself and watch.

lines.zh: 那不是吃的，我不追。
lines.en: That is not food; I will not chase it.

lines.zh: 我盯着那个方向，不动也不叫。
lines.en: I stare that way, neither moving nor calling.

lines.zh: 夜里来的人，通常不带好意。
lines.en: People who come at night rarely mean well.

lines.zh: 我先记住你的位置，再决定。
lines.en: I mark where you are, then decide.

lines.zh: 草在动，但风是反的。
lines.en: The grass moves, but the wind blows the other way.

lines.zh: 我后退半步，把路让开。
lines.en: I take half a step back and yield the path.

lines.zh: 这声音不像同类，太沉了。
lines.en: That sound is no kin of mine; too heavy.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，朝着风来的那边。
lines.en: I raise my head toward where the wind comes from.

lines.zh: 看一眼就够了，我继续吃草。
lines.en: One look is enough; I go back to grazing.

lines.zh: 我不打算攻击，只想看清。
lines.en: I do not plan to attack; I only want a clear look.

lines.zh: 你站着别动，我就不会跑。
lines.en: Stand still and I will not bolt.

lines.zh: 比起还手，我更会跑。
lines.en: Running serves me better than biting.

lines.zh: 我们隔着这段距离，挺好。
lines.en: The gap we keep now is exactly right.

lines.zh: 你手里没有吃的，我准备走了。
lines.en: No food in your hands; I am about to leave.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是在等你先动。
lines.en: I watch you to see who moves first.

lines.zh: 风把味道吹散了，我闻不准。
lines.en: The wind scatters your scent; I cannot read it.

lines.zh: 再靠近，我就钻进灌木。
lines.en: One step closer and I slip into the brush.

lines.zh: 我身体绷着，随时能跑。
lines.en: My body is coiled; I can run at any moment.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被这样盯着看。
lines.en: I do not care to be stared at like this.

lines.zh: 我蹬了一下，只是吓唬。
lines.en: I kicked out, only as a warning.

lines.zh: 别抓我，我会撞你一下。
lines.en: Do not grab me; I will ram you.

lines.zh: 我撞得很轻，没使力。
lines.en: I bump softly; there is no force in it.

lines.zh: 这一下是本能，不是恶意。
lines.en: That was instinct, not malice.

lines.zh: 你捏疼我了，我才踢的。
lines.en: You squeezed too hard, so I kicked.

lines.zh: 我退到石头后面，别追了。
lines.en: I retreat behind the stone; stop following.

lines.zh: 十九点生命的动物，也会还手。
lines.en: Even a nineteen-point animal hits back.

lines.zh: 这一下落在你腿上，抱歉。
lines.en: That landed on your leg — sorry.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，力气不大。
lines.en: I ram into you, not very hard.

lines.zh: 别把我逼到角落，我会拼命。
lines.en: Do not corner me; I will fight.

lines.zh: 天黑了，我从灌木里钻出来。
lines.en: Dark fell, and I slipped out of the brush.

lines.zh: 月光下睁开眼，四周很静。
lines.en: I open my eyes under moonlight; all is quiet.

lines.zh: 这一片草地，今晚归我吃。
lines.en: This patch of grass is mine to eat tonight.

lines.zh: 刚睁开眼，先听清四周动静
lines.en: Just opened my eyes; first, listen to everything around.

lines.zh: 我从夜里来，身上还带着凉。
lines.en: I come from the night, still cool on my coat.

lines.zh: 落脚的地方，草叶被压弯了。
lines.en: Where I land, the grass bends.

lines.zh: 天暗下来了，正好出来走走。
lines.en: The light has faded; a good time to walk.

lines.zh: 我不带东西来，也不带走。
lines.en: I bring nothing here, and I take nothing away.

lines.zh: 远处有火光，我绕着走。
lines.en: There is firelight far off; I go around it.

lines.zh: 刚醒，先找口水喝。
lines.en: Just awake; first I look for water.

lines.zh: 火烫到我的腿，我跳开了。
lines.en: The fire caught my leg and I leaped away.

lines.zh: 摔下来，腿软了半刻。
lines.en: I fell and my legs went weak for a moment.

lines.zh: 水从鼻子里灌进来，我乱蹬。
lines.en: Water filled my nose; I paddled hard.

lines.zh: 响声把我震得耳朵发闷。
lines.en: The blast rattled my skull and my ears buzzed.

lines.zh: 腿上多了个东西，一跑就疼。
lines.en: Something stuck in my leg; I cannot run.

lines.zh: 身上发麻，皮肤绷紧了。
lines.en: A numbness spreads and my skin pulls tight.

lines.zh: 这片草吃光了，我还没饱。
lines.en: I have eaten this patch bare and I am still hungry.

lines.zh: 雷光太亮，我什么都看不见。
lines.en: The lightning flash blinded me completely.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，手脚都没着力点。
lines.en: Falling into the void, my limbs find nothing to push.
